p: (רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג צח, א):
when the two Tablets were given
from the side of the Tree of Life,
for the two days of Shavuos
the Two Loaves, which are Hei and Hei."
At first glance this is astonishing,
שֶׁהֲרֵי שָׁבוּעוֹת אֵינוֹ רַק יוֹם אֶחָד,
for Shavuos is only one day,
and the second Yom Tov of the Diaspora
is kept only out of doubt,
and in Eretz Yisrael they do not keep at all
the second Yom Tov of the Diaspora;
be alluded to in the Name Havayah?
But this appears to lend support
that there are two days of Shavuos:
from the side of Torah she'b'al peh,
in which the primordial light was revealed —
the dew of Atika, Toras chesed —
the sixth is the time of Matan Torah,
as it was in the original Thought.
וּשְׁבִיעִי הוּא זְמַן מַתַּן תּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב,
And the seventh is the time of the giving of Torah she'b'chsav,
which is from the side of Gevurah;
and it is the letter Vav,
And so it is written in the holy Zohar
(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קכב, ב):
ו׳ אִיהוּ עַל רֵישָׁא דְּבַר נָשׁ,
וּמִינֵּיהּ יֵעוּל עַל פּוּמָא דְּבַר נָשׁ
and from it there enter into a person's mouth
And this was given to them on the third day,
the Middle Pillar, which is Rachamim,
then the Torah was given them from the side of Gevurah"
(as brought in the holy Zohar, Yisro,
שֶׁזָּכַרְנוּ; זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב פא, א).
וּמִקּוֹדֶם נִיתַּן לָהֶם הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
But before that they were given Torah she'b'al peh,
which is the fixing of the words of Torah:
that the words of Torah become fixed in their heart
after they receive and hear the words of Torah,
so that they can taste the flavor of the words of Torah —
שֶׁהוּא עִיקַּר וְשׁוֹרֶשׁ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה;
which is the essence and root of Torah she'b'al peh;
and this was given to them on the sixth.
what is brought in the holy Zohar
"that Yisrael were crowned with seventy crowns
That is, the night leading into the third day,
וְהוּא יִרְאַת ה׳ טְהוֹרָה (תְּהִלִּים יט, י).
and it is "the pure fear of Hashem" (Tehillim 19:10).
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב הָרַמְבַּ״ן (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא יב, א);
and it is "a spirit from that Kodesh above
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר חֵלֶק ג סא, א);
and this is the letter Yud.
וְהַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה נִיתְּנָה בְּשִׁשִּׁי בְּסִיוָן;
And Torah she'b'al peh was given on the sixth of Sivan;
for when the light of Torah she'b'al peh is revealed —
and it is the primordial light that was hidden within it —
then the utterance "Let there be light" comes into effect,
the second utterance, corresponding to Chochmah,
שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ כְּבָר אֵיזֶה תְּפִיסָה מָה.
in which there is already some measure of graspability.
as it was in the Thought, to be created;
and according to the Thought, the Torah was given on the sixth,
And although in the Introduction to the Tikkunim it says
"And when it was taken from Chesed
and when it was taken from Gevurah
it was called Torah she'b'al peh" —
that Torah she'b'chsav is from the side of Gevurah
and Torah she'b'al peh is Toras chesed —
the explanation is that in truth Torah she'b'chsav
comes from the side of Gevurah,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁמּוּבָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר לְמַעְלָה;
as brought in the holy Zohar cited above;
אַךְ לָנוּ נִיתַּן מֵה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּחֶסֶד,
but to us it was given by Hashem Yisbarach with Chesed,
the morning of Avraham, the attribute of Chesed;
וְזֶה מִימִינוֹ אֵשׁ דָּת לָמוֹ (דְּבָרִים לג, ב).
and this is "from His right hand, a fiery law for them" (Devarim 33:2).
but to Yisrael it was given with Gevurah,
"A young Torah scholar who flares up —
it is the Torah that makes him boil,
That is, the giving to Yisrael
was with the attribute of Gevurah;
"rather, these are the mighty men of Torah."
And this is Torah she'b'al peh:
when the primordial light hidden within it is revealed —
then it is as it arose in the Thought
to create with the attribute of Din, the attribute of Gevurah.
From the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
תּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב מִסִּטְרָא דִּגְבוּרָה קָא אַתְיָא
Torah she'b'chsav comes from the side of Gevurah
and Torah she'b'al peh is Toras chesed;
but as for the giving to Yisrael —
Torah she'b'chsav, which is from the side of Gevurah,
was given on the third day, which is Rachamim,
and "when it was morning," the attribute of Chesed;
וְתוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה נִיתְּנָה לָנוּ בִּגְבוּרָה.
while Torah she'b'al peh was given to us with Gevurah.
And this is "the two days of Shavuos,
the sixth is the letter Yud, yirah;
וְתוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה, שֶׁהוּא מִדַּת מַלְכוּת,
and Torah she'b'al peh, which is the attribute of Malchus,
and "a spirit from the Kodesh above," Chochmah.
And the seventh is the letter Vav:
Torah from the side of Gevurah, the letter of truth.
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמַר אַחַר כָּךְ בְּרַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא
And this is what he says next in the Raya Mehemna
"The Omer of barley is animal food," etc.,
וְאַתֵּן צֹאנִי צֹאן מַרְעִיתִי אָדָם אַתֶּם.
'And you, My flock, the flock of My pasture, you are man.'"
That is, regarding Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom,
מָצִינוּ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה עג, יא, סוֹף הַפָּרָשָׁה)
we find (Bereishis Rabbah 73:11, end of the chapter)
שֶׁהָיָה לוֹ שִׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא עֶדְרֵי צֹאן,
that he had six hundred thousand flocks of sheep,
the Rabbanan say one million two hundred thousand;
and they do not disagree," etc.
And the number six hundred thousand
indicates the kedushah of Knesses Yisrael,
Yisrael were in the aspect of sheep,
for the kedushah of the aspect of "you are man" —
לֹא זָכוּ רַק אַחַר מַתַּן תּוֹרָה,
they merited only after Matan Torah,
when they merited the beauty of Adam HaRishon
as he was before the corruption.
the very beauty of Adam HaRishon,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁמּוּבָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א קמב, ב),
as brought in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 142b),
שֶׁהָיָה כְּמוֹ אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן קוֹדֶם הַחֵטְא;
who was like Adam HaRishon before the sin;
but for his offspring he did not merit
וְעַד מַתַּן תּוֹרָה הָיוּ בִּבְחִינַת צֹאן.
and until Matan Torah they were in the aspect of sheep.
And Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom, too
שֶׁהֶחֱזִיק עַצְמוֹ גַּם כֵּן בִּבְחִינַת צֹאן.
for he too regarded himself as in the aspect of sheep.
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (מִדְרַשׁ תְּהִלִּים כג, ב):
אֵין לְךָ אוּמָּנוּת בְּזוּיָה מִן הָרוֹעֶה וְכוּלֵּי,
"There is no occupation more lowly than the shepherd," etc.;
רַק אָמַר דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם:
yet Dovid HaMelech, alav hashalom, said:
he regarded himself as in the aspect of sheep.
And especially the flocks, which allude to his offspring,
הָיוּ בֶּאֱמֶת בִּבְחִינַת צֹאן עַד מַתַּן תּוֹרָה,
were truly in the aspect of sheep until Matan Torah,
when they merited the aspect of "you are man."
And on Atzeres, the time of the giving of our Torah,
when they had already merited being called "man,"
אָז הַקׇּרְבָּן לַחֲמוּ בְלַחְמִי (מִשְׁלֵי ט, ה),
then the offering is "come, eat of My bread" (Mishlei 9:5),
and this is the Two Loaves.
